picks.file: Panorama of Kaunas by Tomasz Makowski, 1600.jpg
picks.why: true view of the walled town with labeled churches and castle on the river

picks.what: Engraving in Jacob Koppmayer’s Theatrum cosmographico-historicum
picks.why: only P2 view; town across the river; text column and key trimmed. Low resolution (about 580 px after trim)

picks.file: Kowno dzisiejsza stolica Żmudzi (A. Oleszczyński, A. Czapski, 1850).jpg
picks.what: View from the hills above the town, engraving
picks.why: highest-resolution copy of this view; Jesuit church towers and the river; decorative frame and verses trimmed

picks.what: The old town riverfront and the wartime pontoon bridge, photograph (Polona)
picks.why: high resolution; Jesuit church, town hall tower and Vytautas church; same bridge as the 1915 Kriegs-Echo photo (#9)

picks.file: View of Kaunas from Church of Christ's Resurrection 03.JPG
picks.what: The old town seen from the Church of Christ’s Resurrection
picks.why: only modern view showing the old town; distant, gray sky

gaps: P0: no candidates; P3: only Raffet’s 1839 painting of Marshal Ney in 1812 (event scene, no city)
notes: #4 (about 1873) is a strong riverfront panorama but low resolution with a page fold through the middle, and too close to 1850 for a second P4 view; swap for #6 if preferred. #5, #7, #8 are other copies of the 1850 Oleszczyński view. #2 is derived from the Makowski composition. P6 pick is weak; replace if a better old-town or skyline photo turns up.
